business_problem: Enpal needed a hot-data platform that could ingest more than 200 real-time feeds from solar panels, batteries, heat pumps, and EV chargers, support rapid growth across Europe, and do so at a lower cost than its earlier blob-storage approach.
solution_summary: Enpal adopted MongoDB Atlas with MongoDB Time Series Collections to run the hot-data layer behind its connected energy platform. The company gathers live telemetry from tens of thousands of solar arrays, heat pumps, and EV chargers so customers can track usage while Enpal forms a virtual power plant from the aggregate view. Atlas stores and serves that stream data, replacing a blob-storage pattern that would not scale cleanly as the fleet grows by an order of magnitude. Enpal also uses MongoDB aggregation pipelines to query the time-series workload without managing joins, and it combines Atlas with Azure Event Hub so raw and transformed device data can be persisted before being streamed into MongoDB for hot access. The architecture supports geographic sharding for compliance, keeps colder data accessible in a lake environment, and dramatically lowers the cost of processing as Enpal expands its renewable-energy network.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Provides the hot-storage data platform for Enpal's connected energy devices and customer-facing services.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Time Series Collections
solution_components.role: Stores high-volume telemetry from solar, heat-pump, and EV-charger devices in a format optimized for time-series analysis.

data_flow: Energy devices stream raw and transformed telemetry through Azure Event Hub, Enpal persists the hot operational feed in MongoDB Atlas using Time Series Collections, customer and operational services query that hot store for recent metrics, and colder history remains accessible through a data lake.
business_outcome: Enpal expects roughly 60% lower data-processing costs, can support up to 100,000 devices on a single cluster, and has a foundation for customer energy tracking plus revenue-generating grid participation as it expands.
